rationale: The short thesis required RTO to stay below VWAP and the 5m 9-EMA, but price has reclaimed the 9-EMA ($20.26) and pushed to $20.32, with recent 1m candles rising on heavier volume toward VWAP ($20.35). With the position already adverse and invalidation only about 5 cents away, the original downside edge is no longer present, and there is not enough confirmation to justify a long flip.
